I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to provide a summary of our recent meeting to ensure clarity and alignment on the next steps.

- We reviewed the initial design concepts and gathered client feedback.

**Action Items:**
- Emma will update the project plan based on the client's feedback.
- David will coordinate with the development team to start the initial phase.

**Next Meeting:**
- The next meeting is scheduled for **June 1, 2024**.

Please let me know if there are any additional questions or if you need further details. I look forward to our continued collaboration.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
